loudness.note: Track loudness fields are null until the import script measures the downloaded files; players treat null as gainDb 0.

curation.why: Too fast/peppy, suspenseful or eerie for focus, or filed under a genre it doesn’t sound like (catalogue tempo, energy, loudness range).

Rebuilt so each genre sounds like its name and suits focus. 115 candidates measured from the audio (level swings, sudden jumps, silent gaps, onset rate, pulse, brightness, speech-like modulation), then checked against the composer's own tags and notes; anything startling, dissonant, eerie, vocal or off-genre was left out. Everything is AAC to stay inside the size budget.
